key_insight: Multi-turn LLM assistants can feel helpful for NFR assessment, but their judgments are often inaccurate versus expert ground truth.
engineering_relevance: For software teams using AI copilots on compliance and other NFR tasks, interaction design matters as much as answer quality.
method: 148 HIPAA-derived NFRs were assessed on the iTrust codebase
Measured satisfaction level, reasoning, and code localization across dialogue turns
evidence_signal: The study found developers often agreed with the LLM, yet accuracy against expert ground truth remained low.
watch_item: Do not rely on user agreement alone as a proxy for correctness in compliance-sensitive NFR workflows.
paper_title: Accuracy and Satisfaction in Multi-Turn LLM Dialogues for NFR Assessment
